name: Arsa Roti
ingredients: Oil or Ghee for deep frying
instructions: 1. Heat water in a heavy-bottomed pan and add grated jaggery to make a syrup of one-string consistency.
2. Gradually add rice flour to the syrup while stirring continuously to avoid lumps.
3. Turn off the heat and mix in the sesame seeds, then let the dough cool until it is handleable.
4. Grease your palms with oil or water and take small portions of the dough, flattening them into circular discs.
5. Heat oil in a deep pan and deep-fry the discs on medium heat until they turn deep golden brown and crispy on both sides.
6. Remove and drain excess oil on paper towels.
description: Arsa Roti is a traditional sweet delicacy of Jharkhand, commonly prepared during festivals, weddings, and special celebrations. It is a dense, chewy, and sweet bread that is loved for its long shelf life and rustic flavor, representing the cultural heritage of the tribal communities in the region.
